name: 公園の遊具・集会室の料金を設定
summary: 条例には、公園の占用料や有料施設の使用料に関する規定があります。この議案では、板橋公園の交通遊具と第1・第2集会室の料金を加えます。また、指定管理者が公園の行為許可や有料施設の使用に関する業務を行い、利用料金を受け取る仕組みを設けます。
changes: 付帯設備の使用料を1利用単位あたり1,000円以内で規則に定める
交通遊具の料金を大型はおとな1周200円・こども1周100円、小型は1台10分100円とし、3歳未満は無料にする
板橋公園内第1・第2集会室の使用料を午前600円、午後800円、夜間700円にする
指定管理者が区長の承認を得て利用料金を定め、区長の基準に従って減額・免除や還付を行える仕組みを設ける
who: 板橋公園の交通遊具を利用する人
板橋公園内の第1・第2集会室を利用する人
公園で行為の許可を受ける人
why: 指定管理者に行わせる業務を追加し、新設する有料施設と使用料を定めるなど、必要な規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Sets fees for park rides and meeting rooms
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Itabashi City Parks Ordinance
en.summary: The ordinance contains provisions on fees for occupying parks and fees for using paid facilities. This bill adds fees for the traffic rides and Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 at Itabashi Park. It also establishes a system under which the designated manager handles permits for activities in parks and work related to the use of paid facilities, and receives the user fees.
changes: Set the fee for using ancillary equipment by rule at no more than ¥1,000 per use unit
Set fees for the large traffic rides at ¥200 per ride for adults and ¥100 per ride for children, and for small rides at ¥100 per 10 minutes per unit; make them free for children under 3
Set the fees for Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 at Itabashi Park at ¥600 for the morning, ¥800 for the afternoon and ¥700 for the evening
Establish a system under which the designated manager sets user fees with the ward mayor’s approval and may reduce or waive fees or issue refunds in accordance with the ward mayor’s standards
who: People using the traffic rides at Itabashi Park
People using Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 at Itabashi Park
People who receive permission to carry out activities in parks
en.why: The ward says this is to add duties for the designated manager and put in place necessary provisions, including setting fees for newly established paid facilities and their use.
